Built For Developers

Isolated Workspaces
Each user gets their own directory, credentials, and chat history. No cross-contamination.
Git Identities
Personal GitHub tokens and SSH keys per user. Commits go under your name.
Worktree Sessions
Parallel sessions in independent git worktrees. Refactor and fix bugs simultaneously.
Token Optimization
RTK, Caveman, and Ponytail reduce token usage by up to 65%.
